subject: Cardholder declined twice at grocery store
body:
Hi team,

One of our cardholders (token crd_7c21e) was declined twice today at a grocery store, about 10 minutes apart. Funds are available on our side, the balance is well above the purchase amount. In the dashboard the decline reason shows response code 65.

Other cards for the same customer worked fine this afternoon. Could you tell us why this one was declined and whether we need to change a limit on our end?

Thanks,
Priya

subject: Card declined at gas station
body: Card crd_88f0a declined at a gas station, reason code 05. Customer is standing at the pump. Please advise.

subject: All our cardholders declined at one online travel merchant
body:
Hello,

Since yesterday evening every cardholder who tries to pay at Skyline Travel Online gets declined. It is only this merchant, other online purchases succeed normally. We have 9 complaints so far and our support queue is filling up.

Sample from our authorization log:

2026-10-06T13:41:07Z auth_id=aut_41d9 card=crd_1a77 merchant="Skyline Travel Online" mcc=4722 amount=412.00 currency=USD response=57 reason=transaction_not_permitted
2026-10-06T13:52:31Z auth_id=aut_41f3 card=crd_9b02 merchant="Skyline Travel Online" mcc=4722 amount=1180.50 currency=USD response=57 reason=transaction_not_permitted
2026-10-06T14:05:12Z auth_id=aut_4207 card=crd_5e6c merchant="Skyline Travel Online" mcc=4722 amount=96.00 currency=USD response=57 reason=transaction_not_permitted

We have not changed our card program configuration in the last 30 days. Did something change on your side for travel agencies (MCC 4722)? We need to know whether this is intended before we tell customers anything.

Regards,
Daniel Okafor
Payments Operations, Marlow Wallet

subject: Contactless declines abroad
body:
Hi, three of our cardholders traveling in Portugal this week report that tap-to-pay is declined at shops, while chip and PIN works. In our dashboard the declines show reason code 05, do not honor. No other cardholders seem affected.

Is there a fraud rule or country setting we should check? Not urgent for us but the customers are a bit annoyed.

Thanks!
Mei

subject: Sandbox test card declined
body: hey, sandbox: the test card from your docs gets declined on a $1.00 authorization, response 14 invalid card number. we are trying to finish our integration demo for friday. prod is fine. can u check if the sandbox test cards changed?

subject: Missing card.settled webhooks since Oct 8
body:
Hi support,

We stopped receiving card.settled webhooks around 02:00 UTC on Oct 8. card.authorized events are still arriving fine, so the endpoint itself is reachable. Our reconciliation job is now behind because it relies on the settled events.

From our server logs (endpoint /webhooks/payments):

2026-10-08T01:58:44Z POST /webhooks/payments 200 event=card.authorized id=evt_a1c3
2026-10-08T01:59:12Z POST /webhooks/payments 200 event=card.authorized id=evt_a1c4
(no card.settled requests after this point)

In your dashboard under Webhooks > Deliveries I can see card.settled deliveries marked "pending retry" with attempt count 7. We never see the requests on our side.

We checked our WAF and nothing is blocking your IP ranges. Can you tell us what is happening to those deliveries and re-send the missed events once fixed? About 1,900 settled events are missing as of now.

Thanks,
Tomas Reyes
Copperleaf Money Engineering

subject: Your retries are hammering our endpoint
body: We deployed a bad build and our webhook endpoint returned 503 for about 40 minutes (09:10 to 09:50 UTC). Now you are retrying and the backlog is hitting our servers all at once. Can you pause deliveries for 30 minutes, or tell us the retry schedule so we can plan capacity? Request id for the first failure: req_c07d.

subject: Webhook signature verification failing
body:
Since we rotated our webhook signing secret yesterday our verification fails on every event. We compute HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with the new secret and compare against the X-Signature header. It never matches. Example from one event:

header:   t=1760004112,v1=5d41c3f9e0a7b2c8
computed: 7a93e0c4b15d6f20

Did the secret rotation propagate on your side? Or is the signature format different from the docs (do we need to include the timestamp prefix in the signed payload)? Our handler rejects the events with 401, so everything is queued.

subject: Duplicate card.authorized events
body:
We are seeing the same event delivered twice. evt_5d20 and evt_5d21 both carry auth_id aut_9917 and identical payloads, about 3 seconds apart. It has happened for roughly 5% of authorizations since Monday. Our handler is not idempotent so we double-posted a few holds on cardholder balances (fixed manually).

Is this expected behavior? Should we dedupe on auth_id?

subject: Sandbox webhooks not arriving
body: Webhooks to https://hooks.orchardvine.example/payments are not arriving in sandbox. Prod is fine.

subject: 401 after rotating API key
body:
Hello,

We rotated our production API key this morning following the process in the docs and now every call from our back-office tool returns 401. We updated the key in our secrets manager and redeployed.

$ curl -i https://api.paymentsplatform.example/v1/cards/crd_3d19 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_REDACTED"
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
x-request-id: req_71be
{"error":{"code":"invalid_api_key","message":"The provided API key is not valid."}}

Customer card payments are not affected. It is our back-office calls (card freezes, limit changes) that fail. Can you check whether the old key was revoked before the new one was activated?

subject: 403 on POST /v1/cards in production
body:
Same key, same payload: 201 in sandbox, 403 in production.

Response: {"error":{"code":"forbidden","message":"Key lacks scope cards:create"}}
Request ID: req_e4a8

We were told at go-live that all scopes would be enabled. Can you check the key scopes on our production app?

subject: 400 when creating cardholders
body:
Creating a cardholder started failing with 400 yesterday. Nothing changed in our code as far as I can tell.

Request:
POST /v1/cardholders
{"first_name":"Ana","last_name":"Silva","email":"ana@mailbox.example","billing_address":{"line1":"12 Rua Exemplo","city":"Lisbon","country":"PT"}}

Response (400):
{"error":{"code":"validation_error","message":"Invalid request","details":[{"field":"billing_address.postal_code","issue":"required"}]}}

The docs page for cardholders does not list postal_code as required for PT. Is this a new rule? If yes please update the docs. We get about 200 signups per day and they all hit this.

subject: Python SDK crashes after upgrade
body:
After upgrading the Python SDK from 2.3.1 to 2.4.0 we get this on every call:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "app/payments.py", line 58, in create_transfer
    resp = client.transfers.create(amount=amount, currency="USDC", destination=dest)
  File ".../sdk/resources/transfers.py", line 112, in create
    return self._post("/v1/transfers", json=body, idempotency_key=idempotency_key)
TypeError: _post() got an unexpected keyword argument 'idempotency_key'

Pinning back to 2.3.1 fixes it. Python 3.11. Staging only so far. Looks like a bug in 2.4.0?

subject: 409 on idempotent retries
body:
We retry transfer creation on timeouts with the same Idempotency-Key, as the docs recommend. About 1 in 50 retries returns 409 idempotency_key_in_use instead of the original response. Original request req_b930, retry req_b93f.

Should we wait before retrying, or is the 409 our signal that the first request succeeded?

subject: Offramp transfer pending for 36 hours
body:
Offramp transfer tr_0c5e8 has been in status "pending" since Oct 9 09:12 UTC. Amount is 25,000 USDC and the destination is our bank account on file, which we have used for offramps before without problems. Your docs say settlement takes 1 business day.

The on-chain transfer to your deposit address is confirmed:
0x728d1087908ae8b177b922520c80123e5a2b2d90d93707c2901b8be8fac13a5e

Can you tell us what it is waiting on?

subject: Deposit confirmed on-chain but not credited
body:
A customer sent 4,200 stablecoin to the deposit address assigned to account acct_7f3d. Hash:
0x48e0982a7c87a4c20d24ca096a0e22dab76f3fd611adea4f49f59286fbf0a814

14 confirmations on the explorer. The balance still shows 0 after 3 hours. The customer has a trade to settle today and is asking us for updates every few minutes.

subject: Ledger vs statement mismatch for Oct 6
body:
Daily reconciliation for Oct 6 shows our ledger total as 2,884,310.12 and your statement total as 2,885,514.67. Difference: 1,204.55.

We went through the transaction list line by line and cannot find a missing entry. I can send both CSVs. Could you confirm whether any fee adjustments or reversals were posted after the cut-off?

subject: Completed transfer has no transaction hash
body: Transfer tr_91ab2 shows status "completed" in the API but the tx_hash field is null. Our customer's receiving wallet says nothing arrived. How can we prove the transfer went out? We need the hash.

subject: Large payout not settled before cutoff
body: Our daily payout of 480,000 stablecoin (batch pay_2026_10_11) normally settles by 15:00 UTC. It is 18:30 and it is still pending. We have a contractor payroll run tomorrow morning that depends on these funds. No error on our side. Can someone check the status and give us an ETA?

subject: 502 on transfers
body: POST /v1/transfers is returning 502 Bad Gateway since a few minutes ago. Error code upstream_connect_error. Request id req_2a91. Anyone else seeing this?

subject: Getting 502s from the API
body:
Our transfer creation calls started failing at around 14:05 UTC.

14:05:33 POST /v1/transfers -> 502 (upstream_connect_error) req_6c1d 1.2s
14:06:10 POST /v1/transfers -> 502 (upstream_connect_error) req_6c20 1.1s
14:07:48 POST /v1/transfers -> 502 (upstream_connect_error) req_6c2b 1.3s
14:08:02 GET /v1/balances -> 200 req_6c2e 0.2s

Reads work, creating transfers does not. Retrying with backoff has not helped. Our payout queue is stuck.

subject: URGENT - API down??
body: URGENT: your API is down!!! all our transfers fail with 502 upstream_connect_error. customers cannot send money. we are escalating internally. we need an update in the next 15 minutes please

subject: Latency spike on authorizations
body: Since about 08:00 UTC the p95 response time of POST /v1/cards/{id}/authorize has gone from roughly 300 ms to around 4 seconds. Nothing is failing outright, but some merchant terminals time out at 5 seconds. Only the authorize endpoint is slow; /v1/balances is normal. Is there a known degradation?

subject: Intermittent timeouts on balances
body: About 1 in 5 requests to GET /v1/balances time out at our 10 second client limit since 08:00 UTC today. The rest are fast. Your status page shows all systems operational. Request ids of two timeouts: req_d3f1 and req_d3f8.

subject: User stuck in verification for 5 days
body: End user usr_4c82 submitted a passport and proof of address on Oct 4. The status has been verification_pending for 5 days. Your docs say it normally takes up to 48 hours. The user has emailed us twice. Can you tell us if anything else is needed?

subject: Customer account frozen, rent due
body:
Hi, one of our customers (usr_91de) has had her account frozen since Friday with no explanation. Her rent is due on the 15th and all her money is in the account. She called us in tears. We cannot tell her anything because the dashboard just says compliance_hold.

Please tell us what is needed to release it, or at least what we can tell her.

subject: Selfie rejected four times
body: A user keeps failing the selfie step. The rejection reason is image_too_blurry every time. We tried it ourselves in good light and it passes. Four attempts logged for usr_20f6 (ver_a1, ver_a2, ver_a3, ver_a4). Maybe their phone camera? Is there a manual review option?

subject: Payouts on hold, source of funds request
body:
Outgoing payouts on our business account have been on compliance hold since Oct 7. We got an email asking for source of funds documentation, but it is generic and does not say which documents are acceptable. We sent our last 3 months of bank statements and a business registration extract on Oct 8 and have had no reply since.

Who should we talk to? Payouts to our contractors are delayed.

subject: 140 users stuck in verification_pending
body:
We ran an onboarding campaign on Oct 11 and about 140 users signed up and submitted their KYC documents. All of them are in verification_pending and none have moved in 24 hours. Earlier signups were processed in minutes.

Is the verification queue backed up, or do we need to submit differently? I can send the list of user ids.

subject: Filter transactions by card in the API
body: Hi! How do I list only the transactions for one card using the API? I see a card_id parameter mentioned in one place in the docs but it does not seem to work on /v1/transactions. Thanks

subject: Feature request: card.frozen webhook
body: We would like a webhook event when a card gets frozen (by us, by the cardholder, or by your fraud system). Today we have to poll for it. Is this on the roadmap? Happy to be a design partner.

subject: More networks for stablecoin deposits?
body: Do you plan to support stablecoin deposits on additional blockchain networks? Many of our users hold funds on networks that are not on your list. If it is planned, is there a timeline? Just planning our roadmap, no rush.

subject: Rotating API keys without downtime
body: What is the recommended way to rotate production API keys without downtime? Can two keys be active at the same time during the changeover? I could not find this in the docs.

subject: Simulating declines in sandbox
body: Is there a way to test our custom fraud rules in sandbox with simulated declines? I would like to trigger a velocity decline without making 20 real test authorizations.

subject: THIS IS UNACCEPTABLE
body:
I AM SICK OF THIS. THE CSV EXPORT FROM THE DASHBOARD PUTS THE DATE COLUMN IN A DIFFERENT FORMAT EVERY TIME AND MY FINANCE TEAM HAS TO FIX IT BY HAND. I HAVE ASKED THREE TIMES. IF THIS IS NOT FIXED BY FRIDAY WE ARE MOVING TO ANOTHER PROVIDER. YOUR SUPPORT IS A JOKE.

EVERYTHING ELSE WORKS. BUT THIS IS RIDICULOUS.

subject: Heads up on card payments
body:
Hi team, hope you are having a good week.

Probably nothing, but I wanted to flag that our dashboard has shown a 100% decline rate on card authorizations since about 06:30 UTC. Every attempt comes back with response 96 (system_malfunction), across all merchants and all of our roughly 38,000 active cards. It is about 08:40 now, so a bit over two hours.

No rush on our side. Whenever someone has a moment to take a look would be great. We will keep an eye on it.

Thanks,
Sam

subject: Webhook errors and a stuck business verification
body:
Two things:

1) Your webhook deliveries to us have been failing with HTTP 500 since Tuesday. It is a bug on our side and we are fixing it, but we will need the missed events replayed afterwards (about 300 card.authorized events).

2) Separately, a business customer of ours, usr_b7714, has been in compliance_hold for 6 days after submitting company documents. Their director keeps asking what is missing.

Can you help with both? Thanks.

subject: not working
body: Hi, things are not working properly since this morning. Our customers are complaining. Can someone look at it? Thanks.

subject: 504 errors from your API
body:
We are getting 504 Gateway Timeout on every call to your API from our production servers since this morning. We moved to a new data center overnight. Calls from our staging server and from my laptop work fine. The old servers worked until yesterday.

I cannot find anything for these calls in your dashboard logs, so I have no request ids to give you. Our customers cannot create transfers right now.
